ai_summary: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited (AHCL) has announced its participation in two significant investor conferences, the Jefferies India Forum and Kotak Healthcare Forum, scheduled for September 2026. These physical meetings, including group and one-on-one interactions, aim to enhance investor engagement and visibility for the company. AHCL explicitly states that no unpublished price-sensitive information or forward-looking statements will be disclosed, adhering to fair disclosure practices and mitigating selective information release.
